elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 82, a local enterprise organisation is defined as a local enterprise agency, a training and enterprise council, a Scottish local enterprise company, or a business link organisation.
elements.quote: For the purposes of section 82 “local enterprise organisation” means— (a) a local enterprise agency, (b) a training and enterprise council, (c) a Scottish local enterprise company, or (d) a business link organisation.

elements.requirement: A local enterprise agency is defined as a body for the time being approved as a local enterprise agency for the purposes of section 82 by the relevant national authority.
elements.quote: “Local enterprise agency” means a body for the time being approved as a local enterprise agency for the purposes of section 82 by the relevant national authority

elements.requirement: For England or Northern Ireland, the relevant national authority with the power to approve a local enterprise agency is the Secretary of State.
elements.quote: the Secretary of State (in relation to England or Northern Ireland)

elements.requirement: For Scotland, the relevant national authority with the power to approve a local enterprise agency is the Scottish Ministers.
elements.quote: the Scottish Ministers (in relation to Scotland)

elements.requirement: For Wales, the relevant national authority with the power to approve a local enterprise agency is the National Assembly for Wales.
elements.quote: the National Assembly for Wales (in relation to Wales)

elements.requirement: Sections 84 and 85 provide further rules governing approvals of local enterprise agencies by the relevant national authority.
elements.quote: For further provision about approvals by the relevant national authority, see sections 84 and 85.

elements.requirement: A training and enterprise council is defined as a body with which the Secretary of State has an agreement to carry out the functions of a training and enterprise council.
elements.quote: “Training and enterprise council” means a body with which the Secretary of State has an agreement under which the body is to carry out the functions of a training and enterprise council.

elements.requirement: A Scottish local enterprise company is defined as a company with which Scottish Enterprise or Highlands and Islands Enterprise has an agreement to carry out the functions of a local enterprise company.
elements.quote: “Scottish local enterprise company” means a company with which— (a) Scottish Enterprise, or (b) Highlands and Islands Enterprise, has an agreement under which the company is to carry out the functions of a local enterprise company.

elements.requirement: A business link organisation is defined as a person authorised by or on behalf of the Secretary of State to use a trade mark designated by the Secretary of State for the purposes of subsection 83(5).
elements.quote: “Business link organisation” means a person authorised by or on behalf of the Secretary of State to use a trade mark designated by the Secretary of State for the purposes of this subsection.
